cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(kin_release_fixture LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(KIN_TEST_MODULE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake" CACHE PATH "Kin release modules for fixture")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${KIN_TEST_MODULE_DIR}")
option(KIN_ENABLE_LTO "Exercise IPO policy on legacy dependencies" ON)
set(KIN_ENABLE_SIZE_OPTIMIZATIONS ON)
set(KIN_PACKAGE_DEBUG_SYMBOLS ON)
set(KIN_PACKAGE_STRIP ON)
if(KIN_ENABLE_LTO)
    include(CheckIPOSupported)
    check_ipo_supported(RESULT supported OUTPUT error LANGUAGES C CXX)
    if(NOT supported)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "${error}")
    endif()
endif()
include(kin_release)
include(kin_packaging)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_subdirectory(legacy)
add_executable(release_fixture main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(release_fixture PRIVATE legacy_release_library)
kin_package_game(release_fixture RUNTIME_TARGETS legacy_release_library)
kin_apply_release_tree("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

get_target_property(package_name release_fixture KIN_PACKAGE_NAME)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fixture-package-$<CONFIG>.cmake" CONTENT
    "set(PACKAGE_NAME ${package_name})\nset(EXECUTABLE $<TARGET_FILE_NAME:release_fixture>)\n")
